_comment: News selection sources (owner-approved redesign 2026-10-05). official = labs, big tech, chips, robots/AVs and their CEOs: any post above min_faves enters the pool. outlets = top tech outlets, reporters and AI news accounts: only posts matching the tech keyword filter enter (their politics never does). discovery = all of X at a high like floor; it only DISCOVERS, a discovery story needs an official or outlet post on the same story before it can run. Saar approves new accounts.
tech_filter: (AI OR OpenAI OR ChatGPT OR Anthropic OR Claude OR Gemini OR Nvidia OR Apple OR iPhone OR Google OR Microsoft OR Meta OR robot OR humanoid OR chip OR Waymo OR Tesla OR SpaceX OR startup OR billion)
discovery: (OpenAI OR ChatGPT OR Anthropic OR Claude OR Gemini OR DeepMind OR Nvidia OR "AI model" OR humanoid OR robotaxi OR iPhone OR "artificial intelligence") lang:en
video_discovery: (robot OR humanoid OR robotaxi OR Waymo OR "self-driving" OR "AI glasses" OR "Figure 03" OR Unitree OR Optimus) filter:videos lang:en -drone
ai_video_discovery: (Sora OR Veo OR "Grok Imagine" OR Kling OR "AI generated" OR "made with AI") filter:videos lang:en
